x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
closest_diff = 1e15
best_pair = (0, 0)

def evaluate(b, a):
    global closest_diff, best_pair
    current_diff = abs((a / b) - (x / y))
    if current_diff + 1e-15 < closest_diff:
        closest_diff = current_diff
        best_pair = (b, a)

for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a1 = (x * b) // y
    a2 = a1 + 1
    evaluate(b, a1)
    evaluate(b, a2)

print(f"{best_pair[1]}/{best_pair[0]}")
